---
title: "Collab data inital analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

Download necessary libraries
```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

```

Input count data
```{r}
# Read in count data
count_file <- "<original_archive>/RNASEQ_DATA/Bui/gene_counts.txt"
countdata <- read.table(count_file, 
                        header = TRUE, 
                        row.names = 1, 
                        sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
# 1) copy
countdata_clean <- countdata

# 2) remove the first featureCounts annotation columns
annot_n <- 5
counts_only <- countdata_clean[, -(1:annot_n), drop = FALSE]

# (optional) keep gene IDs as rownames if Geneid exists
if ("Geneid" %in% colnames(countdata_clean)) {
  rownames(counts_only) <- countdata_clean$Geneid
}

# 3) rename BAM/sample columns step by step manner:
old <- colnames(counts_only)

new <- old
new <- sub("^X\\.", "", new)                    # remove leading "X." (from make.names)
new <- sub("^.*STAR_Bui\\.", "", new)           # keep only after "STAR_Bui."
new <- sub("(_S\\d+).*", "\\1", new)            # keep up to "_S##" only

colnames(counts_only) <- new
```


Input and edit metadata
```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("<original_archive>/RNASEQ_DATA/Bui/Metadata_transcriptome_Bui2024_CK.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#Refine the metadata
#drop both columns if they exist
metadata <- metadata[, !names(metadata) %in% c("X", "X.1"), drop = FALSE]
#remove rows where Phenotype_transcriptome is N/A (not RIF or fertile)
metadata <- metadata[metadata$Phenotype_transcriptome != "N/A", , drop = FALSE]
#remove blank rows
metadata <- metadata[rowSums(trimws(as.matrix(metadata)) != "") > 0, , drop = FALSE]

```


adjusting the column/row names to match
```{r}
#minor adjustments
#META DATA
#all upper case in metadata
metadata$Sample_p.number <- toupper(metadata$Sample_p.number)
#all underscores from dashes in metadata
metadata$Sample_p.number <- gsub("-", "_", metadata$Sample_p.number)
#add leading 0 into metadata to match countdata
metadata$Sample_p.number <- sub("^(P\\d{2})_", "\\1_0", metadata$Sample_p.number)
#COUNT DATA
#all underscores in count data
colnames(counts_only) <- sub("\\.", "_", colnames(counts_only))

#1) build a match key from counts_only colnames (drop the _S## part)
counts_key <- sub("_S\\d+.*$", "", colnames(counts_only))

#2) choose where your sample IDs live in metadata
# If your sample IDs are in a column (MOST common), put the column name here:
meta_id_col <- "Sample_p.number"   # <-- CHANGE this to your actual column name

meta_key <- trimws(metadata[[meta_id_col]])

# (optional) if metadata IDs also sometimes contain _S stuff, strip it too
meta_key <- sub("_S\\d+.*$", "", meta_key)

#3) reorder metadata to match counts_only, using the keys
idx <- match(counts_key, meta_key)

# safety checks
if (anyNA(idx)) {
  missing <- counts_key[is.na(idx)]
  stop("These counts samples didn't match anything in metadata: ",
       paste(unique(missing), collapse = ", "))
}
if (any(duplicated(counts_key))) stop("Duplicate keys in counts_only after stripping _S.")
if (any(duplicated(meta_key)))   stop("Duplicate keys in metadata sample IDs.")

metadata <- metadata[idx, , drop = FALSE]

#4) now you can set metadata rownames to the FULL counts_only colnames
rownames(metadata) <- make.unique(colnames(counts_only))

```

sanity check: colnames match rownames
```{r}
all(colnames(counts_only) == rownames(metadata))
```

Quality control and filtering the data
```{r,  fig.height=9, fig.width=11}
# Check library sizes: these are the total counts per sample
librarysizes <- colSums(counts_only)
print(librarysizes)

# Visualize library sizes to detect potential outliers
barplot(librarysizes, main = "Library Sizes", ylab = "Total Counts", las = 2)
```

save 
```{r}
out_dir <- "<original_archive>/RNASEQ_DATA"

write.csv(counts_only, file.path(out_dir, "Bui_counts.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(metadata,    file.path(out_dir, "Bui_metadata.csv"),    row.names = TRUE)

```
